venues.name: Panther Coffee
venues.verdict: The name that started Miami's specialty coffee wave — Panther is the shop every local mentions first.
venues.whatToOrder: Their signature cold brew is dangerously smooth, but the single-origin pour-overs are where Panther really flexes. Grab a bag of freshly roasted beans to take home.

venues.name: Vice City Bean
venues.address: 1657 N Miami Ave Unit C, Miami, FL 33136
venues.verdict: An OG of Miami's specialty coffee scene with a spacious, industrial vibe perfect for working or unwinding.
venues.whatToOrder: The cappuccino is excellent, but the Iced Strawberry Matcha Latte made with real strawberry puree and vanilla oat milk is the unexpected star — summer in a cup.

venues.name: Suite Habana Café
venues.verdict: A quiet love letter to Cuban coffee culture — all soul, no gimmicks. The highest-rated coffee spot in Wynwood.
venues.whatToOrder: Café con leche with a fresh guava pastelito. The space is modeled after a paladar — a private home restaurant in Cuba — complete with Cuban tiles and a Celia Cruz mural.

venues.name: Surry Hills Coffee
venues.verdict: Aussie coffee culture meets Miami sunshine — perfect flat whites and all-day brunch in a cozy Little River retreat.
venues.whatToOrder: The flat white is silky, balanced, and topped with latte art so pretty you'll hesitate before sipping. Pair it with the AvoToast with hummus, cranberries, and dukkah.

venues.name: Café Grumpy
venues.address: 2516 Ponce de Leon Blvd, Coral Gables, FL 33134
venues.verdict: Brooklyn's certified woman-owned roaster brings serious, no-frills specialty coffee to Coral Gables — freshly roasted beans shipped weekly.
venues.whatToOrder: The regular latte is excellent, but try the signature Honey Oat Latte — espresso, natural honey, oat milk, and a dash of cinnamon. Think cozy New York winters in a cup.

venues.name: Libertino Café
venues.verdict: Wynwood's sleekest café serves Danish La Cabra specialty coffee — the best espresso in the neighborhood, hands down.
venues.whatToOrder: Have the latte or cappuccino hot with a little honey. If you're there for brunch, the Egg & Bacon Waffle with incredibly crispy bacon is the move.

venues.name: BIGFACE
venues.verdict: Jimmy Butler's Design District coffee shop is bold, playful, and surprisingly serious about its espresso. Come for the vibes, stay for the quality.
venues.whatToOrder: A regular hot latte — delicious, well-balanced, and served at just the right temperature. The espresso is rich and smooth. Streetwear and coffee gear add neon pops to the space.

venues.name: I Think She Is (ITSI)
venues.verdict: Brickell's coziest hidden gem — retro vibes, leather couches, and the kind of place you tell yourself you'll stay for one drink but linger for hours.
venues.whatToOrder: The 12oz latte (served in an actual cup — rare in Miami) and the Chuck Norris — a carrot and OJ mix. For food, try the Eggspicy Toast with avocado and feta.

venues.name: Neverland Coffee Bar
venues.address: 17830 W Dixie Hwy, North Miami Beach, FL 33160
venues.verdict: The highest-reviewed coffee shop in greater Miami with 3,400+ Google reviews — a whimsical brunch destination worth the drive to North Miami Beach.
venues.whatToOrder: The award-winning iced coffee or the hot golden coffee — espresso, almond milk, turmeric, cinnamon, coconut oil, ghee, brown sugar, and condensed milk. Their everlasting brunch covers everything.

venues.name: Cortadito Coffee House
venues.verdict: Sometimes you just want a classic Cuban coffee that hits every time — smooth, strong, and perfectly sweet. Cortadito delivers exactly that.
venues.whatToOrder: Café con leche paired with a pastelito de guayaba. It's casual, fast, and full of heart — the quintessential Miami coffee experience.

venues.name: Ludlow Coffee Supply
venues.verdict: Manhattan's Lower East Side favorite has landed in Brickell's lobby scene — Dua Lipa's go-to NYC spot now serves Miami.
venues.whatToOrder: The Bourbon Vanilla Iced Latte is a fun twist — slightly sweet, well-balanced, and served with nugget ice that elevates the entire drink.

venues.name: Per'La Specialty Roasters
venues.verdict: Miami's most serious local roaster — they supply the beans to White Rose and other top cafés. The roastery itself is a pilgrimage for coffee purists.
venues.whatToOrder: Ask what single-origin they're featuring that week and have it as a pour-over. Their beans power some of Miami's best cafés, so tasting at the source is special.
